"""Hand-computed lifecycle scenarios against the project agent."""
import json, sys
sys.path[:0] = ['/workspace/project', '/opt/emicro-deps']
from ebpf.helper import Agent

LIM = {'images': 16, 'cells': 262144, 'units': 1024, 'contexts': 32768,
       'connections': 4096, 'packets': 32768, 'files': 8192}
AB = [{'name': 'A', 'label': 1}, {'name': 'B', 'label': 2}]
U32 = 4294967295
DENY = U32
failures = 0


def agent(services=AB, limits=None):
    return Agent(services, dict(LIM, **(limits or {})))


def check(name, got, want):
    global failures
    if got != want:
        failures += 1
        print('FAIL %-28s got=%s want=%s' % (name, json.dumps(got, separators=(',', ':')),
                                             json.dumps(want, separators=(',', ':'))))
    else:
        print('ok   %s' % name)


def stage(a, epoch, policy='match(A,B) allow;'):
    return a.event({'op': 'stage', 'epoch': epoch, 'policy': policy})


OK = {'ok': True}
RJ = {'error': 'rejected'}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- epoch rules
a = agent()
check('stage first', stage(a, 5), {'ok': True, 'epoch': 5, 'image': {
    'accept': [False, False, True], 'rows': [[1, DENY], [DENY, 2], [DENY, DENY]]}})
check('stage same epoch', stage(a, 5), RJ)
check('stage lower epoch', stage(a, 4), RJ)
check('retire active', a.event({'op': 'retire', 'epoch': 5}), RJ)
check('commit before active', a.event({'op': 'commit', 'epoch': 5}), OK)
check('retire referenced none', a.event({'op': 'retire', 'epoch': 5}), OK)
check('retire gone', a.event({'op': 'retire', 'epoch': 5}), RJ)
check('stage after retire keeps mark', stage(a, 5), RJ)
check('stage higher', stage(a, 6), {'ok': True, 'epoch': 6, 'image': {
    'accept': [False, False, True], 'rows': [[1, DENY], [DENY, 2], [DENY, DENY]]}})
check('retire unknown', a.event({'op': 'retire', 'epoch': 99}), RJ)
check('commit unknown', a.event({'op': 'commit', 'epoch': 99}), RJ)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- capacities
a = agent(limits={'images': 1})
check('images1', stage(a, 1), {'ok': True, 'epoch': 1, 'image': {
    'accept': [False, False, True], 'rows': [[1, DENY], [DENY, 2], [DENY, DENY]]}})
check('images1 full', stage(a, 2), RJ)
a = agent(limits={'cells': 2})
check('cells fit', stage(a, 1)['ok'], True)
a = agent(limits={'cells': 1})
check('cells tight', stage(a, 1), RJ)
a = agent()
check('cells of empty language', stage(a, 1, ''), {'ok': True, 'epoch': 1, 'image': {
    'accept': [False], 'rows': [[DENY, DENY]]}})

# -------------------------------------------------------- identity generations
a = agent()
check('spawn', a.event({'op': 'spawn', 'unit': [0, 1, 1], 'service': 'A'}), OK)
check('spawn busy', a.event({'op': 'spawn', 'unit': [0, 1, 2], 'service': 'A'}), RJ)
check('spawn unregistered', a.event({'op': 'spawn', 'unit': [0, 2, 1], 'service': 'Z'}), RJ)
check('spawn other ns', a.event({'op': 'spawn', 'unit': [7, 1, 1], 'service': 'B'}), OK)
check('exit', a.event({'op': 'exit', 'unit': [0, 1, 1]}), OK)
check('respawn old generation', a.event({'op': 'spawn', 'unit': [0, 1, 1], 'service': 'A'}), RJ)
check('respawn new generation', a.event({'op': 'spawn', 'unit': [0, 1, 3], 'service': 'A'}), OK)
check('exit unknown generation', a.event({'op': 'exit', 'unit': [0, 1, 2]}), RJ)
a = agent(limits={'units': 2})
check('units cap', [a.event({'op': 'spawn', 'unit': [0, i, 1], 'service': 'A'}) for i in (1, 2, 3)],
      [OK, OK, RJ])
a = agent()
check('spawn exhausted generation', a.event({'op': 'spawn', 'unit': [0, 1, U32], 'service': 'A'}), OK)
check('spawn cannot increment', a.event({'op': 'spawn', 'unit': [0, 1, U32], 'service': 'A'}), RJ)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ clone
a = agent()
stage(a, 1, 'match(A,B) allow;')
a.event({'op': 'commit', 'epoch': 1})
a.event({'op': 'spawn', 'unit': [0, 1, 1], 'service': 'A'})
a.event({'op': 'begin', 'unit': [0, 1, 1], 'rid': 4})
check('clone wrong parent generation',
      a.event({'op': 'clone', 'parent': [0, 1, 2], 'child': [0, 2, 1]}), RJ)
check('clone', a.event({'op': 'clone', 'parent': [0, 1, 1], 'child': [0, 2, 1]}), OK)
check('clone census', a.event({'op': 'inspect'}), {'ok': True, 'active': 1, 'images': [[1, 3, 2, 2]],
                                                   'units': 2, 'contexts': 2, 'connections': 0,
                                                   'packets': 0, 'files': 0})
check('clone mark inherited', a.event({'op': 'begin', 'unit': [0, 2, 1], 'rid': 4}), RJ)
check('clone higher rid', a.event({'op': 'begin', 'unit': [0, 2, 1], 'rid': 5}),
      {'ok': True, 'epoch': 1, 'state': 1})
check('clone finish parent context independent',
      a.event({'op': 'finish', 'unit': [0, 1, 1], 'rid': 4}), {'ok': True, 'allow': False})
check('clone child context survives',
      a.event({'op': 'finish', 'unit': [0, 2, 1], 'rid': 4}), {'ok': True, 'allow': True})
a = agent(limits={'contexts': 2})
a.event({'op': 'stage', 'epoch': 1, 'policy': 'match(A,B) allow;'})
a.event({'op': 'commit', 'epoch': 1})
a.event({'op': 'spawn', 'unit': [0, 1, 1], 'service': 'A'})
a.event({'op': 'begin', 'unit': [0, 1, 1], 'rid': 1})
a.event({'op': 'begin', 'unit': [0, 1, 1], 'rid': 2})
check('clone needs two slots', a.event({'op': 'clone', 'parent': [0, 1, 1], 'child': [0, 2, 1]}), RJ)
check('clone census unchanged', a.event({'op': 'inspect'}), {'ok': True, 'active': 1, 'images': [[1, 3, 2, 2]],
                                                             'units': 1, 'contexts': 2, 'connections': 0,
                                                             'packets': 0, 'files': 0})

# ------------------------------------------------------- pinned epoch advance
a = agent()
stage(a, 1, 'match(A,B) allow;')
a.event({'op': 'commit', 'epoch': 1})
a.event({'op': 'spawn', 'unit': [0, 1, 1], 'service': 'B'})
check('begin B first', a.event({'op': 'begin', 'unit': [0, 1, 1], 'rid': 1}),
      {'ok': True, 'epoch': 1, 'state': DENY})
stage(a, 7, 'match() allow;')
a.event({'op': 'commit', 'epoch': 7})
check('finish uses pinned epoch', a.event({'op': 'finish', 'unit': [0, 1, 1], 'rid': 1}),
      {'ok': True, 'allow': False})

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ transport
a = agent()
stage(a, 3, 'match(A,B) allow;')
a.event({'op': 'commit', 'epoch': 3})
a.event({'op': 'spawn', 'unit': [0, 1, 1], 'service': 'A'})
a.event({'op': 'spawn', 'unit': [0, 2, 1], 'service': 'B'})
a.event({'op': 'begin', 'unit': [0, 1, 1], 'rid': 1})
check('send without connection', a.event({'op': 'send', 'unit': [0, 1, 1], 'rid': 1,
                                          'connection': [9, 1], 'stream': 1, 'destination': 'B'}), RJ)
a.event({'op': 'open', 'connection': [9, 1]})
check('open again same id', a.event({'op': 'open', 'connection': [9, 2]}), RJ)
check('open old generation after close', a.event({'op': 'close', 'connection': [9, 1]}), OK)
check('reopen must exceed', a.event({'op': 'open', 'connection': [9, 1]}), RJ)
check('reopen higher', a.event({'op': 'open', 'connection': [9, 2]}), OK)
check('send unregistered destination', a.event({'op': 'send', 'unit': [0, 1, 1], 'rid': 1,
                                                'connection': [9, 2], 'stream': 1, 'destination': 'Z'}), RJ)
WIRE = '454d43340000000300000001000000020000000100000002'
check('send', a.event({'op': 'send', 'unit': [0, 1, 1], 'rid': 1, 'connection': [9, 2],
                       'stream': 1, 'destination': 'B'}), {'ok': True, 'wire': WIRE})
check('send stream repeat', a.event({'op': 'send', 'unit': [0, 1, 1], 'rid': 1, 'connection': [9, 2],
                                     'stream': 1, 'destination': 'B'}), RJ)
check('send no context', a.event({'op': 'send', 'unit': [0, 1, 1], 'rid': 7, 'connection': [9, 2],
                                  'stream': 2, 'destination': 'B'}), RJ)
check('recv wrong service', a.event({'op': 'recv', 'connection': [9, 2], 'stream': 1,
                                     'unit': [0, 1, 1], 'rid': 1, 'wire': None}), RJ)
check('recv bad wire', a.event({'op': 'recv', 'connection': [9, 2], 'stream': 1,
                                'unit': [0, 2, 1], 'rid': 1, 'wire': '0' * 48}), RJ)
check('recv short wire', a.event({'op': 'recv', 'connection': [9, 2], 'stream': 1,
                                  'unit': [0, 2, 1], 'rid': 1, 'wire': WIRE[:-2] + '  '}), RJ)
check('recv upper case', a.event({'op': 'recv', 'connection': [9, 2], 'stream': 1,
                                  'unit': [0, 2, 1], 'rid': 1, 'wire': WIRE.upper()}),
      {'ok': True, 'epoch': 3, 'state': 2})
check('recv duplicate same identity', a.event({'op': 'recv', 'connection': [9, 2], 'stream': 1,
                                               'unit': [0, 2, 1], 'rid': 1, 'wire': None}),
      {'ok': True, 'epoch': 3, 'state': 2})
check('recv duplicate other rid', a.event({'op': 'recv', 'connection': [9, 2], 'stream': 1,
                                           'unit': [0, 2, 1], 'rid': 2, 'wire': None}), RJ)
check('recv duplicate other unit', a.event({'op': 'recv', 'connection': [9, 2], 'stream': 1,
                                            'unit': [0, 3, 1], 'rid': 1, 'wire': None}), RJ)
check('census after delivery', a.event({'op': 'inspect'}),
      {'ok': True, 'active': 3, 'images': [[3, 3, 2, 3]], 'units': 2, 'contexts': 2,
       'connections': 1, 'packets': 1, 'files': 0})
check('finish then duplicate', a.event({'op': 'finish', 'unit': [0, 2, 1], 'rid': 1}),
      {'ok': True, 'allow': True})
check('recv duplicate after finish', a.event({'op': 'recv', 'connection': [9, 2], 'stream': 1,
                                              'unit': [0, 2, 1], 'rid': 1, 'wire': None}), RJ)
check('census after finish', a.event({'op': 'inspect'}),
      {'ok': True, 'active': 3, 'images': [[3, 3, 2, 2]], 'units': 2, 'contexts': 1,
       'connections': 1, 'packets': 1, 'files': 0})
check('retire with packet ref', a.event({'op': 'retire', 'epoch': 3}), RJ)
check('close releases packet', a.event({'op': 'close', 'connection': [9, 2]}), OK)
check('census after close', a.event({'op': 'inspect'}),
      {'ok': True, 'active': 3, 'images': [[3, 3, 2, 1]], 'units': 2, 'contexts': 1,
       'connections': 0, 'packets': 0, 'files': 0})
check('retire now free', a.event({'op': 'retire', 'epoch': 3}), RJ)  # active still 3
a.event({'op': 'commit', 'epoch': 3})
check('retire after commit elsewhere', a.event({'op': 'retire', 'epoch': 3}), RJ)
check('exit releases context', a.event({'op': 'exit', 'unit': [0, 1, 1]}), OK)
check('census exit', a.event({'op': 'inspect'}),
      {'ok': True, 'active': 3, 'images': [[3, 3, 2, 0]], 'units': 1, 'contexts': 0,
       'connections': 0, 'packets': 0, 'files': 0})
check('retire zero refs', a.event({'op': 'retire', 'epoch': 3}), OK)
check('inspect retired', a.event({'op': 'inspect'}),
      {'ok': True, 'active': 3, 'images': [], 'units': 1, 'contexts': 0, 'connections': 0,
       'packets': 0, 'files': 0})

a = agent()
stage(a, 2, 'match(A,B) allow;')
a.event({'op': 'commit', 'epoch': 2})
a.event({'op': 'spawn', 'unit': [0, 1, 1], 'service': 'A'})
a.event({'op': 'begin', 'unit': [0, 1, 1], 'rid': 1})
check('store', a.event({'op': 'store', 'unit': [0, 1, 1], 'rid': 1, 'file': [4, 1]}), OK)
check('store new generation while current',
      a.event({'op': 'store', 'unit': [0, 1, 1], 'rid': 1, 'file': [4, 2]}), RJ)
check('store same generation overwrites',
      a.event({'op': 'store', 'unit': [0, 1, 1], 'rid': 1, 'file': [4, 1]}), OK)
check('store census one file', a.event({'op': 'inspect'}),
      {'ok': True, 'active': 2, 'images': [[2, 3, 2, 2]], 'units': 1, 'contexts': 1,
       'connections': 0, 'packets': 0, 'files': 1})
check('unlink wrong generation', a.event({'op': 'unlink', 'file': [4, 2]}), RJ)
check('unlink', a.event({'op': 'unlink', 'file': [4, 1]}), OK)
check('unlink again', a.event({'op': 'unlink', 'file': [4, 1]}), RJ)
check('restored old generation', a.event({'op': 'store', 'unit': [0, 1, 1], 'rid': 1, 'file': [4, 1]}), RJ)
check('store higher generation', a.event({'op': 'store', 'unit': [0, 1, 1], 'rid': 1, 'file': [4, 2]}), OK)
a.event({'op': 'spawn', 'unit': [0, 2, 1], 'service': 'B'})
check('load advances by reader', a.event({'op': 'load', 'file': [4, 2], 'unit': [0, 2, 1], 'rid': 1}),
      {'ok': True, 'epoch': 2, 'state': 2})
check('load again needs higher rid', a.event({'op': 'load', 'file': [4, 2], 'unit': [0, 2, 1], 'rid': 1}), RJ)
check('load unknown file', a.event({'op': 'load', 'file': [4, 9], 'unit': [0, 2, 1], 'rid': 2}), RJ)
check('load keeps file', a.event({'op': 'load', 'file': [4, 2], 'unit': [0, 2, 1], 'rid': 2}),
      {'ok': True, 'epoch': 2, 'state': 2})
check('file census', a.event({'op': 'inspect'}),
      {'ok': True, 'active': 2, 'images': [[2, 3, 2, 4]], 'units': 2, 'contexts': 3,
       'connections': 0, 'packets': 0, 'files': 1})

# -------------------------------------------------------- denied-path plumbing
a = agent()
stage(a, 1, 'match(A,B) allow;')
a.event({'op': 'commit', 'epoch': 1})
a.event({'op': 'spawn', 'unit': [0, 1, 1], 'service': 'B'})
check('begin denied', a.event({'op': 'begin', 'unit': [0, 1, 1], 'rid': 1}),
      {'ok': True, 'epoch': 1, 'state': DENY})
DENY_WIRE = '454d43340000000100000002' + '000000ff'
a.event({'op': 'open', 'connection': [1, 1]})
check('send from denied', a.event({'op': 'send', 'unit': [0, 1, 1], 'rid': 1, 'connection': [1, 1],
                                   'stream': 1, 'destination': 'A'}),
      {'ok': True, 'wire': '454d433400000001ffffffff000000010000000100000001'})
a.event({'op': 'spawn', 'unit': [0, 2, 1], 'service': 'A'})
check('recv denied stays denied', a.event({'op': 'recv', 'connection': [1, 1], 'stream': 1,
                                           'unit': [0, 2, 1], 'rid': 1, 'wire': None}),
      {'ok': True, 'epoch': 1, 'state': DENY})
check('finish denied', a.event({'op': 'finish', 'unit': [0, 2, 1], 'rid': 1}), {'ok': True, 'allow': False})
check('store denied', a.event({'op': 'store', 'unit': [0, 1, 1], 'rid': 1, 'file': [1, 1]}), OK)
check('load denied', a.event({'op': 'load', 'file': [1, 1], 'unit': [0, 2, 1], 'rid': 2}),
      {'ok': True, 'epoch': 1, 'state': DENY})

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- stage errors
a = agent()
for policy in ['match(Q) allow;', 'match(A) maybe;', 'match(A) allow', 'startswith(A,B,C,D,E) allow;',
               'match(A' + ',A' * 16 + ') allow;', 'not match(A) allow;',
               '(' + 'match(A) and ' * 15 + 'match(A)' + ')' * 15 + ' allow;',
               'match(A)\x0b allow;', 'match(A)\u00a0allow;', 'match(A) allow; match(A) allow; match(A) allow; match(A) allow; match(A) allow; match(A) allow; match(A) allow; match(A) allow; match(A) allow;']:
    check('reject ' + repr(policy[:32]), stage(a, 1, policy), RJ)
check('epoch still free after rejects', stage(a, 1, 'match(A) allow;'), {'ok': True, 'epoch': 1, 'image': {
    'accept': [False, True], 'rows': [[1, DENY], [DENY, DENY]]}})

print('lifecycle failures:', failures)
sys.exit(1 if failures else 0)
